calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS first_period, 6 AS last_period
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_category AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin, COUNT(*) AS n_rows
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.fiscal_year
      AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN params.first_period AND params.last_period
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT category, net_sales, gross_margin, n_rows, ROUND(100.0 * gross_margin / net_sales, 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM by_category
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-05') AS sales_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-05') AS sales_distinct_ids,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-05' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_receipt_lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-05') AS ret_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-05') AS ret_distinct,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26') AS n_loads,

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-05'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN (SELECT * FROM d ORDER BY receipt_id LIMIT 8) d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id

WITH x AS (
  SELECT *, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no) AS c,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-11-10'
)
SELECT MIN(sale_date) AS first_dup_date, MAX(sale_date) AS last_dup_date,
       COUNT(*) AS dup_extra_rows, SUM(net_amount) AS dup_net, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads,
       MIN(etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(etl_loaded_at) AS max_load,
       SUM(CASE WHEN channel_code='WB' OR store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id=900) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS web_rows
FROM x WHERE rn > 1

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.standard_cost, p.standard_unit_cost, p.valid_from, p.valid_to, cp.category,
         ABS(f.standard_cost - f.quantity*p.standard_unit_cost) AS cost_diff
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' AND s.store_id<>999
    AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
)
SELECT category, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN cost_diff>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cost_mismatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN standard_cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_cost,
  SUM(CASE WHEN standard_cost > net_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cost_gt_net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN net_amount <= 0 OR quantity <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos,
  MIN(net_amount) mn, MAX(net_amount) mx,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26') AS dup_return_ids,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id, return_date FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_returns
FROM l GROUP BY category

       ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) / SUM(n.net_sales), 1) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 6
  AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, cp.category
